용담바둑 neural engine — local/offline implementation notes

1. Browser inference and MCTS implementation
Upstream: https://github.com/Sir-Teo/web-katrain
Pinned commit: a6a67d645048a996d606a410c4e4c4b1051ffd43
License: MIT, see LICENSE.web-katrain.txt.
Vendored source closure: src/neural/. Browser entry: src/neural/engine/katago/worker.ts.
Local changes: asset URL resolution relative to bundled worker; explicit one-thread
WASM baseline; Chinese rules adjusted to this app's area scoring, positional
superko, no suicide, and no additional handicap compensation beyond user komi.
Built by: npm ci && npm run build:neural
This is a TypeScript implementation of KataGo neural architecture + PUCT/MCTS,
not the original compiled native KataGo executable. Model strength is not a
certified rank and search speed varies by device.

2. Neural models
Upstream: https://github.com/lightvector/KataGo/tree/master/cpp/tests/models
License: MIT, see LICENSE.KataGo.txt (weights are original repository content).
katago-b6.bin.gz = g170-b6c96-s175395328-d26788732.bin.gz
katago-b10.bin.gz = g170e-b10c128-s1141046784-d204142634.bin.gz
Model SHA-256 and byte size are in models.json.
These are actual pretrained networks, not random/test-initialized parameters.

3. TensorFlow.js 4.22.0 and WASM backend
https://github.com/tensorflow/tfjs/tree/tfjs-v4.22.0
Copyright Google LLC; Apache License 2.0. See LICENSE.TensorFlow.txt.
Additional dependency copyright and license notices from the bundled JS are
preserved in worker.js.LEGAL.txt (including pako/zlib components).
WASM, SIMD WASM, and threaded SIMD WASM artifacts are copied unmodified from
@tensorflow/tfjs-backend-wasm 4.22.0. Browser without cross-origin isolation uses
single-thread SIMD when supported, otherwise ordinary single-thread WASM.

4. pako 2.1.0
https://github.com/nodeca/pako/tree/2.1.0
MIT and zlib license, see LICENSE.pako.txt and bundled legal notices.

5. Integration
strong-engine.js retains a model worker between normal moves. Levels 4 and 5
use b6; level 6 uses b10. Default limits: 32 / 96 / 256 MCTS visits, and
2.2 / 5.5 / 12 seconds of search respectively. Root inference and first model
warmup add overhead. The callback reports actual completed visits and backend.
Only local static files are used; no remote inference or API key. Every selected
move is rechecked by the application's own Go rules before use. Engine failures
are reported, never silently replaced with the old heuristic engine.

5. Human rank profiles
KataGo b18c384nbt-humanv0.bin.gz from official v1.15.0 release.
https://github.com/lightvector/KataGo/releases/tag/v1.15.0
Official pretrained human model; attribution and upstream release retained. Browser code MIT.
Sharded unchanged gzip bytes for static asset limits; SHA-256 in human-model.json.
rank_18k through rank_9d predict human amateur play, not Korean server rating certification.
